name: Mailcow
tagline: Self-hosted mail server. Dockerized, full stack, easy to deploy.
shortDescription: Mailcow is a self-hosted mail server in a Docker stack. Postfix, Dovecot, SOGo webmail, Rspamd anti-spam, full-stack with one docker-compose. The easiest full mail server to deploy.
longDescription:
## What it is

Mailcow is a self-hosted mail server in a Docker stack. Postfix, Dovecot, SOGo (webmail), Rspamd (anti-spam), ClamAV (antivirus), Redis, MariaDB, Nginx, and more — all wired up and managed through a web UI.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a self-hosted mail server that you can get running in an afternoon, Mailcow is the answer. The web UI manages everything: domains, mailboxes, DKIM, quotas, quarantine, and updates.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted email for a small business or organization
- Privacy-sensitive deployments
- When you want a one-command full mail stack
- Replacing Google Workspace / Microsoft 365
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized && cd mailcow-dockerized && ./generate_config.sh && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
installInstructions:
**One-command install:**
```
git clone https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized
cd mailcow-dockerized
./generate_config.sh
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```
UI at `https://your-server:443`.

**Requirements:** Ubuntu/Debian, 6GB+ RAM, 20GB+ disk, dedicated IP.
pricingDetails: Free. GPL-3.0 licensed. Self-host on a dedicated server with 6GB+ RAM.
